response.sql:
WITH race_country_avgs AS (
  SELECT c.country, ds.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country, ds.raceId
), country_avgs AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_country_avgs
  GROUP BY country
), overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS benchmark
  FROM country_avgs
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ob.benchmark
  FROM country_avgs AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > ob.benchmark
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above_overall
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT ao.country,
       ao.avg_wins AS average,
       ao.avg_wins - ao.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark,
       ao.avg_wins - sm.mean_above_overall AS above_second_mean
FROM above_overall AS ao
CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
WHERE ao.avg_wins > sm.mean_above_overall;

assumptions.assumption: Countries with NULL country values are treated like any other country group; races without non-NULL driverStandings.wins contribute no per-race average.
